runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Existing LIVE items are never removed merely because a discovery run does not rediscover them.
runSummary.note: Real 14.9.2026 14:17 sweep across 12 source families: Profesia, direct company careers/public ATS, LinkedIn public jobs indexing, Worki, Kariera/Zoznam, Brigada.sk, Pretlak, StartupJobs, WordPress Jobs, Upwork, Reddit/WordPress communities and publicly indexed Facebook groups. New strong direct-company BA-area candidate: IKEA Pracovnik/cka na oddeleni Sluzby zakaznikom, job 354106, Bratislava, canonical IKEA detail with active Apply, posted 21.8.2026; no foreign-language requirement is visible in the verified detail. LinkedIn surfaced ESET Customer Support Specialist in Bratislava but active English is explicitly required, therefore held/rejected by language ranking. SupportYourApp results require fluent/C1 English or another language and older CloudTalk/Staffino results are inactive. StartupJobs surfaced Medevio 100% remote BDR SK but sales-heavy scope keeps it below promotion threshold. Upwork reverified Website & SEO Management 2026 and surfaced several WooCommerce/e-commerce jobs; most fail compensation, saturation, hire-state or fluent-English gates. Facebook produced 0 verified direct-post hits. No LIVE deletion was performed.

developmentChanges.title: Canonical age vs activity split
developmentChanges.reason: Track posting age separately from current active/apply evidence so an older but still-open canonical vacancy is not incorrectly treated as stale, while truly inactive LinkedIn mirrors are rejected immediately.

developmentChanges.title: Language requirement evidence confidence
developmentChanges.reason: Store whether language demand is explicit mandatory text, preferred wording, inferred from application artifacts, or absent. This prevents search snippets from over- or under-penalizing otherwise strong BA/remote roles.
